messages:
alex: FYI saw a weird periodic saturation signature on eu-west GPU pools this morning, looks like ~2–3m spikes every 10m. not full saturation but enough to trigger scale decisions and thrash batch windows.
maya: saw that too. grafana panel 7 on fleet-saturation shows narrow peaks, correlates with kube-proxy restarts in the same AZ.
tj: ops-bot fired an alert for pool_queue_depth > 1200 for 30s, right? any logs from the autoscaler?
ops-bot: alert: pool_queue_depth_high (severity=warning) triggered for pool:eu-west-gpu-1 count:1324 duration:35s
samir: posting prometheus query that lines up with the peaks: 
```
sum by(pool) (rate(redwood_inference_pool_queue_depth[30s]))
```
peaks match the restart timestamps.
lucy: interesting — if kube-proxy restarts are shrinking the batch window, effective throughput drops and headroom goes negative briefly which trips scale-up. the autoscaler then adds nodes, batch amplifier kicks in -> cost bump.
alex: exact. cost telemetry shows ~12% more burst-capacity spend in that AZ during the window. we need a fix that avoids immediate scale-ups on micro-flaps.
maya: proposal: add a derived metric "effective_batch_window" and a debounce on autoscaler input for queue-derived scaleups. e.g., require sustained queue growth and reduced batch_window for 90s before scaleup.
tj: agree. also add a fallback: if kube-proxy restarts are frequent, prefer routing to other AZs for new requests instead of spinning GPUs. routing policy tweak may be faster and cheaper.
samir: quick grafana query to surface effective_batch_window: 
```
avg_over_time(redwood_inference_batch_window_seconds[2m])
```
and show alongside pool_queue_depth and pod_restarts.
lucy: alert tuning idea: change pool_queue_depth alert to use max_over_time(…) with quantile smoothing and increase firing window to 90s, but keep a short local SLO alert for latency regression to detect true capacity problems.
alex: sounds good. action items: (1) maya to add derived metric + dashboard panel, (2) tj to prototype autoscaler debounce 90s gating, (3) samir to add routing policy experiment, (4) lucy to update alert rules and runbook. can we target a canary rollout tomorrow morning?
maya: i'll add the metric and dashboard this afternoon. will include promql and a panel that overlays pod_restarts.
tj: i'll branch a debounce change in the autoscaler (feature flag), run 1h canary in eu-west-1 AZ B.
samir: I'll prepare a routing policy change that prefers healthy AZs for new requests; sticky sessions should respect KV-cache affinity for pinned sessions.
lucy: updating the alert docs: new threshold, 90s window, add runbook link and cost note.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: autoscaler/debounce-feature -> canary (eu-west-1b) by tj at 08:00 UTC tomorrow.
alex: thanks everyone — please post short status updates in this thread during the canary. if we see cost spike > 8% or latency P50 increase > 50ms, abort and rollback. :thumbsup:
